اعتكدتما (form VIII)
# اِعْتَكَدْتُمَا (iʕtakadtumā) /iʕ.ta.kad.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# اُعْتُكِدْتُمَا (uʕtukidtumā) /uʕ.tu.kid.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
